toegepas.voor: Die ngoma se beesvel is oor 'n wye opening gespan en hoort aan die lae kant.
toegepas.na: Die ngoma, met sy beesvel oor 'n wye opening gespan, hoort aan die lae kant.
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written the grammatical subject of 'hoort aan die lae kant' is the skin, not the drum; the rewrite makes the ngoma the thing that sits on the low side, with no content added.
toegepas.fout: The subject of 'hoort aan die lae kant' is the beesvel rather than the ngoma, in a list headed by where each instrument sits.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The rewrite makes the drum the thing that belongs on the low side, keeps the skin, the wide opening and the protected name, and adds nothing.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'die danser' points back to a dancer never introduced in the lesson; the indefinite article reads naturally for a general statement.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die danser' reads naturally as the dancer wearing the rattles, and the indefinite article loosens that link without fixing a real fault.

laat_vaar.voor: al klink hulle ewe hoog en hard
laat_vaar.na: al klink hulle ewe hoog en ewe hard
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Without the second 'ewe' the phrase can be read as 'equally high, and loud'; repeating it makes clear both qualities are equal.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'ewe hoog en hard' already reads as equal in both, and this is a glossary definition, which a language agent rewords only for a plain error.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The decided definition reads ''n Groep instrumente wat saamgegroepeer word', which repeats 'groep' inside its own explanation and sounds circular to a Grade 4 reader; a person may want to look at it for the whole subject-grade. Not changed.

'Bewegings van die lyf, soos die hande, kop of arms' lists body parts after a head noun that means movements, so strictly it reads 'movements such as the hands'; a subject-wide wording like 'Bewegings van die lyf, soos van die hande, kop of arms' might be worth a person's look. Not changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: speel hulle xilofone wat hulle timbila noem
laat_vaar_vorige.na: speel xilofone wat hulle timbila noem
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The double 'hulle' (possessive, then subject) is clumsy; the possessive adds nothing.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The possessive 'hulle xilofone' carries that these are the Chopi's own instruments, set against the school marimba just before; dropping it loses that and the original reads acceptably.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Praat oor julle eie en mekaar se optredes
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Karakters bou' calques English 'build characters'; Afrikaans creates (skep) a character.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Karakters bou' (building up a character) is accepted drama usage in Afrikaans and may echo the curriculum's wording; 'skep' narrows developing to creating, a lateral move at best.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat in die middel van jou rug loop.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat langs die middel van jou rug af loop.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'In die middel van jou rug loop' can read as walking; 'langs ... af loop' is the idiom for something running down the back.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The ruggraat definition is protected word for word as a shared definition, and 'loop' for something running along the back is ordinary Afrikaans.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoog en laag, hard en sag
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hoog of laag is die vierde van vier ewe goeie vrae
laat_vaar_vorige.na: "Is dit hoog of laag?" is die vierde van vier ewe goeie vrae
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The sentence calls 'hoog of laag' a question, so writing it as the actual question reads more naturally and clearly for a Grade 4 learner.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Calling 'hoog of laag' one of the sorting questions is acceptable shorthand that follows on naturally from the sentences before it, and the proposal adds quotation marks and a question mark to a lesson that holds no questions, so it is only a different way of saying the same thing and adds clutter.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoekom die een trom laer klink as die ander
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: dieselfde vel stywer of slapper trek
laat_vaar_vorige.na: dieselfde vel stywer of slapper span
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'span' is the usual verb for a drumskin and matches 'gespan' used for the same action in the list block, so the learner meets one word for one thing.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Stywer of slapper trek' is natural, clear Afrikaans; 'span' is an equally good word that reads a little oddly with 'slapper', so this is a lateral move rather than a fix.
